decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service in a growing cloud messaging market, it likely meets aspirations, and the firm's slack supports continued investment even though recent website evidence is missing.
Document capture fits the firm's strategic push into electronic document workflows, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger problemistic search and dropping it.
Email and fax conversion uses the firm's core fax infrastructure at low marginal cost and still serves regulated customers, though declining fax demand adds some risk.
This low-cost feature strengthens the established fax business and is more likely to be folded into the base service than formally dropped.
Demand for advanced threat protection is rising among regulated customers, so sandboxing likely exceeds aspirations and remains central to the security portfolio.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a standard, cheap-to-maintain part of the secure email offer, giving no reason to withdraw it.
